pencereler.0-5: A jumbo jet's tail fin blew off in flight. Thirty two minutes later, it
pencereler.5-12: crashed into a mountain, and five hundred twenty people died. The failure started seven years earlier. After a tail
pencereler.12-20: strike, a pressure bulkhead was repaired. The repair used one row of rivets where two were needed. Fatigue cracks grew until the
pencereler.20-30: bulkhead burst. Escaping air tore off the fin and cut the hydraulics. Repairs are now checked against their approved design.

segmentler.metin: Japan Air Lines Flight 123 crashed into a mountain after losing its tail fin.
It took only a faulty repair with one row of rivets where two were needed.
So how could a faulty repair with one row of rivets where two were needed do this?
The answer is fatigue failure of an improperly repaired aft pressure bulkhead — and it is why structural repairs are now inspected against the approved repair design.
